scope: The only two whole-token adjective forms ending in Russian-shaped -ye across the four Latin sources: harakternye at base line 5808 and stepennye at base line 9847.
choice: Repair harakternye svojstva to harakterne svojstva and v stepennye redy to v stepenne redy, preserving the established stems and changing only the plural ending.
motivation: Both targets modify non-animate plural nouns and therefore take the common Interslavic nominative/accusative plural adjective ending -e. The -ye surfaces are isolated Russian transliteration residues; the edition already contains five exact stepenne controls and no harakterne control before this edit.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining -ye was rejected because official adjective grammar supplies -e for non-masculine-animate nominative/accusative plural and no -ye ending.

Changing the lexical stems to harakterističn- or stepenjev-/stepenov- was rejected because this decision is a bounded inflection repair and the current stems are semantically established elsewhere in the edition.
Using genitive/accusative animate -yh was rejected because svojstva are neuter plural and redy are masculine inanimate plural.

evidence.official_grammar: Official adjectives.md, 8142 bytes, SHA-256 184348005ACB532868DAEB35DBFB7A8E05A493D550B4D6FA2E1A3BCFC906D84F, lines 14-18 requires adjective agreement and states that nominative and accusative plural are identical for all genders except masculine animate nouns.
evidence.german_authority: German authority ED0011_noether.tex, 2153594 bytes, SHA-256 9E6BF2BC3155ECE3DF98CD8A408C23662BEFB047A1DDF200CA1DC8476A488BF3: line 5241 has alle charakteristischen Eigenschaften and line 9147 has auf den transzendenten Grundlagen der Potenzreihenentwicklung, confirming the two plural contexts.
evidence.semantic_audit: Base line 5808 has vse harakternye svojstva, with neuter plural svojstva. Base line 9847 has razvijanja v stepennye redy, with accusative plural masculine-inanimate redy.
evidence.protected_domains: Neither target occurs in a comment, foreign-language/title argument, bibliography identity, TeX control name, label, citation key or URL.

validation.coverage: Each exact source token occurs once at its declared locator, and no other whole-token adjective -ye form remains in the four-source scan.
validation.postcondition: Both source forms become zero; harakterne rises to one and stepenne rises from five to six.
validation.structure: Line count, raw brace counts, ordered TeX-control stream and math-delimiter stream are invariant; the other three sources are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The applicator binds all four input and output byte counts and SHA-256 hashes and refuses coverage or locator drift.
